fields.name: Query
fields.definition: The object passed to every ArgentSea data method to name the SQL to execute. It carries the SQL text or procedure name, the command type, a name used in logging and in the mock-results lookup, and optional query parameter names. It has two concrete forms, QueryProcedure and QueryStatement. Applications conventionally expose every Query as a static property of one `Queries` class, so usage is visible by reference count. A Query is the handle; the query contract is the interface it stands for.
